segments.sn56.41:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
segments.sn56.41:1.3: “bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, aññataro puriso rājagahā nikkhamitvā ‘lokacintaṃ cintessāmī’ti yena sumāgadhā pokkharaṇī tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā sumāgadhāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre nisīdi lokacintaṃ cintento.
segments.sn56.41:1.4: Addasā kho, bhikkhave, so puriso sumāgadhāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre caturaṅginiṃ senaṃ [caturaṅginisenaṃ (ka.)] bhisamuḷālaṃ [bhisamūlālaṃ (pī. ka.)] pavisantaṃ.
segments.sn56.41:1.7: Yaṃ loke natthi taṃ mayā diṭṭhan’”ti.
segments.sn56.41:2.1: “Atha kho so, bhikkhave, puriso nagaraṃ pavisitvā mahājanakāyassa ārocesi –
segments.sn56.41:2.3: Yaṃ loke natthi taṃ mayā diṭṭhan’”ti.
segments.sn56.41:2.4: “Kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, ambho purisa, ummatto kathaṃ viceto?
segments.sn56.41:2.5: Kiñca loke natthi yaṃ tayā diṭṭhan”ti?
segments.sn56.41:2.6: “Idhāhaṃ, bhante, rājagahā nikkhamitvā ‘lokacintaṃ cintessāmī’ti yena sumāgadhā pokkharaṇī tenupasaṅkamiṃ; upasaṅkamitvā sumāgadhāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre nisīdiṃ lokacintaṃ cintento.
segments.sn56.41:2.7: Addasaṃ khvāhaṃ, bhante, sumāgadhāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre caturaṅginiṃ senaṃ bhisamuḷālaṃ pavisantaṃ.
segments.sn56.41:2.8: Evaṃ khvāhaṃ, bhante, ummatto evaṃ viceto.
segments.sn56.41:2.9: Idañca loke natthi yaṃ mayā diṭṭhan”ti.
segments.sn56.41:2.10: “Taggha tvaṃ, ambho purisa, ummatto taggha viceto.
segments.sn56.41:2.11: Idañca loke natthi yaṃ tayā diṭṭhan”ti.
segments.sn56.41:3.1: “Taṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, so puriso bhūtaṃyeva addasa, no abhūtaṃ.
segments.sn56.41:3.3: Tasmiṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, saṅgāme devā jiniṃsu, asurā parājiniṃsu.
segments.sn56.41:3.4: Parājitā ca kho, bhikkhave, asurā bhītā bhisamuḷālena asurapuraṃ pavisiṃsu devānaṃyeva mohayamānā.
segments.sn56.41:4.2: ‘sassato loko’ti vā ‘asassato loko’ti vā,‘antavā loko’ti vā ‘anantavā loko’ti vā,‘taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīran’ti vā ‘aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīran’ti vā,‘hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti vā ‘na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti vā,‘hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti vā,‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti vā.
segments.sn56.41:4.4: Nesā, bhikkhave, cintā atthasaṃhitā nādibrahmacariyakā na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati.
segments.sn56.41:5.1: “Cintentā kho tumhe, bhikkhave,‘idaṃ dukkhan’ti cinteyyātha … pe …‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti cinteyyātha.
segments.sn56.41:5.3: Esā, bhikkhave, cintā atthasaṃhitā esā ādibrahmacariyakā esā nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.
segments.sn56.41:6.1: “Tasmātiha, bhikkhave,‘idaṃ dukkhan’ti yogo karaṇīyo … pe …‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yogo karaṇīyo”ti.

lines: Lokacintaṃ cintentoti,“kena nu kho candimasūriyā katā, kena mahāpathavī, kena mahāsamuddo, kena sattā uppāditā, kena pabbatā, kena ambatālanāḷikerādayo”ti evarūpaṃ lokacintaṃ cintento nisīdi.
Bhūtaṃyeva addasāti te kira asurā sambarimāyaṃ samparivattetvā yathā ne so puriso hatthiassādīsu āruhante ukkhipitvā, bhisamuḷālacchiddehi pavisante passati, evaṃ adhiṭṭhahiṃsu.
Tasmāti yasmā lokacintaṃ cintento ummattakopi hoti, tasmā.
Vigatacittoti attatthaparatthato apagatavitakko addasa evaṃ adhiṭṭhahiṃsūti sambandho.
Sambarimāyanti sambarena asurindena uppāditaṃ asuramāyaṃ, yaṃ “indajālan” tipi vuccati indassa mohanatthaṃ uppāditattā.
Yathā neti ne asure yathā so puriso passati, evaṃ adhiṭṭhahiṃsu.
Taṃ purisaṃ tattha tathānisinnaṃ disvā “ayañca devo”ti āsaṅkantā tathā adhiṭṭhahitvā bhisamuḷālachiddehi pavisitvā attano asurabhavanaṃ gatā.
